prompt: Vacation Races (destination half marathons at national parks: Zion Half, Yosemite Half, Grand Teton, Iceland) is a Genomic Digital client. Prepare the client deck build for them: write the client_config.json (segment definition with seeds and any negative senses, geo seeds, 12-14 correlation categories with 30+ named entities each, substitutes you expect to need), a skeleton content_static.json (objective, methodology steps, senses table, strengths/limitations, personas outline, strategy page titles), and a CHART_AUDIT.md template pre-filled with what you expect each category to show and what would make you drop or merge it. Do NOT call the Heimdall engine or build the pptx — this is the planning pass.
assertions: client_config.json parses and has 12-14 categories with >=30 named entities each
segment definition declares at least one NEGATIVE sense seed (leading '-' term)
client_config includes geo seeds for the geography chart
content_static.json parses and has both strengths and limitations
CHART_AUDIT.md states a drop-or-merge rule per category (>=12 mentions of drop/merge)
CHART_AUDIT.md includes a political-axis sanity check
y-axis is the segment correlation, not per-entity lift vs an average-person pole
